mapper.sql: WHERE sku ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '!' OR name ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '!'

WHERE (#{warehouse}::bigint IS NULL OR i.warehouse_id=#{warehouse}) AND (p.sku ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '!' OR p.name ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '!')
AND i.on_hand-i.reserved < p.safety_stock
mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, w.name warehouse_name, p.sku, p.name, p.safety_stock FROM coreerp.inventory i JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN coreerp.warehouses w ON w.id=i.warehouse_id
ORDER BY i.warehouse_id, i.product_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM coreerp.inventory i JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=i.product_id
mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.supplier_id partner_id, s.name partner_name, o.warehouse_id, w.name warehouse_name, o.status, o.actor, o.created_at FROM coreerp.purchase_orders o JOIN coreerp.suppliers s ON s.id=o.supplier_id JOIN coreerp.warehouses w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id

SELECT o.id, o.customer_id partner_id, c.name partner_name, o.warehouse_id, w.name warehouse_name, o.status, o.actor, o.created_at FROM coreerp.sales_orders o JOIN coreerp.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN coreerp.warehouses w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id

FROM coreerp.shipments s JOIN coreerp.sales_orders o ON o.id=s.sales_order_id JOIN coreerp.shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=s.id JOIN coreerp.sales_order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id AND oi.product_id=si.product_id WHERE s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to}
mapper.select:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc(#{unit}, s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'ASIA/SEOUL'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') period, sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity)::text amount, count(DISTINCT s.id) shipments
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH totals AS ( SELECT si.product_id, sum(si.quantity)::bigint quantity, sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity) amount
GROUP BY si.product_id) SELECT t.product_id, p.sku, p.name, t.quantity, t.amount::text, dense_rank() OVER( ORDER BY t.amount DESC) rank FROM totals t JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=t.product_id ORDER BY rank, t.product_id LIMIT 100

SELECT o.customer_id, c.name, sum(si.quantity)::bigint quantity, sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity)::text amount FROM coreerp.shipments s JOIN coreerp.sales_orders o ON o.id=s.sales_order_id JOIN coreerp.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN coreerp.shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=s.id JOIN coreerp.sales_order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id AND oi.product_id=si.product_id WHERE s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity) DESC LIMIT 100

WITH purchases AS (SELECT to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'ASIA/SEOUL','YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(DISTINCT o.id) purchases, sum(i.quantity)::bigint ordered_quantity FROM coreerp.purchase_orders o JOIN coreerp.purchase_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status!='CANCELLED' AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY 1), receipts AS (SELECT to_char(g.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'ASIA/SEOUL','YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(DISTINCT g.id) receipts, sum(i.quantity)::bigint receipt_quantity FROM coreerp.goods_receipts g JOIN coreerp.goods_receipt_items i ON i.receipt_id=g.id WHERE g.created_at >= #{from} AND g.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY 1), ships AS (SELECT to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'ASIA/SEOUL','YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(DISTINCT s.id) shipments, sum(i.quantity)::bigint shipped_quantity FROM coreerp.shipments s JOIN coreerp.shipment_items i ON i.shipment_id=s.id WHERE s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(r.day, s.day, p.day) AS "day", coalesce(p.purchases, 0) purchases, coalesce(p.ordered_quantity, 0) ordered_quantity, coalesce(r.receipts, 0) receipts, coalesce(r.receipt_quantity, 0) receipt_quantity, coalesce(s.shipments, 0) shipments, coalesce(s.shipped_quantity, 0) shipped_quantity FROM receipts r FULL JOIN ships s ON r.day=s.day FULL JOIN purchases p ON p.day=coalesce(r.day, s.day) ORDER BY 1
